items.title: 68437_Charles Thompson oral history interview
items.q: It was Buck Clayton on trumpet and it was Emmett Berry on trumpet... and there was --let's see on the bass there was -- who was the bass player.

ctx.x: It was Buck Clayton on trumpet and it was Emmett Berry on trumpet, and it was Dickie Wells on trombone, and there was Earle Warren on alto, and there was Buddy Tate on tenor, and there was --let's see on the bass there was -- who was the bass player. I can't remember the player.
